name: Illustrative Endowment Plan
death_benefit: Illustrative benefit subject to policy terms
surrender: Terms and value require insurer confirmation

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: Premiums are payable at the frequency and for the period shown in the policy schedule.
clauses.explanation: Premiums are due on the schedule and for the payment period selected. Check the official schedule for amounts, dates, and what happens after a missed payment.

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: The maturity benefit is payable on survival of the life assured to the end of the policy term, subject to policy conditions.
clauses.explanation: A maturity payout may be due if the insured person survives to the policy end date and the contract conditions are met. Confirm the guaranteed amount and any non-guaranteed additions.

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: Surrender value, if any, is determined under the applicable policy schedule and conditions.
clauses.explanation: Ending the policy early may return less than the premiums paid, or no amount during some periods. Ask the insurer for a current surrender-value illustration.

name: Illustrative Participating Whole-Life Plan
maturity: Illustrative long-duration benefit; terms require confirmation
death_benefit: Illustrative benefit subject to policy terms
surrender: Terms and value require insurer confirmation

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: Any bonus is subject to declaration by the insurer and the terms applicable to the policy.
clauses.explanation: A participating policy may receive additions only when declared under its rules. Treat projected additions as non-guaranteed unless the official contract says otherwise.

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: The death benefit is payable to the nominee or beneficiary subject to policy conditions and proof requirements.
clauses.explanation: A benefit may be payable to the recorded nominee after the insurer receives required documents and verifies the claim. Check exclusions, nomination details, and proof requirements.

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: Surrender benefits, where applicable, are calculated under the policy schedule and contract conditions.
clauses.explanation: Cash value on early exit depends on the contract and timing. Request an insurer-issued value before making a decision.

name: Illustrative Money-Back Life Plan
maturity: Illustrative scheduled payouts and maturity benefit
death_benefit: Illustrative benefit subject to policy terms
surrender: Terms and value require insurer confirmation

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: Survival benefits, if applicable, are payable at the milestones and in the amounts stated in the policy schedule.
clauses.explanation: Some plans pay portions of the benefit at set dates if policy conditions are met. Check each date and amount in the official schedule.

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: A policy may enter a grace period or lapse as provided in the applicable terms.
clauses.explanation: If a premium is missed, a limited payment window or other policy options may apply. Check the grace period and effect on benefits with the insurer.

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: The claimant shall submit the forms and supporting documents specified by the insurer for assessment.
clauses.explanation: The claimant must provide the insurer’s required forms and supporting records. Get the current checklist directly from the insurer before submitting.

name: Illustrative Term Life Plan
maturity: No maturity benefit in this illustrative example
death_benefit: Illustrative benefit subject to policy terms
surrender: No surrender value in this illustrative example

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: The sum assured is payable on death of the life assured during the policy term, subject to policy conditions.
clauses.explanation: A benefit may be payable if the insured person dies while cover is active and contract conditions are met. Confirm exclusions, claim proof and nominee details in the official policy.

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: Premiums must be paid as stated in the policy schedule to maintain cover, subject to the grace period and lapse provisions.
clauses.explanation: Cover may be affected if premiums are not paid within the allowed period. Check the grace period, revival rules and consequences of lapse.

clauses.text: Illustrative wording: Benefits may be restricted in circumstances set out in the exclusions and applicable regulations.
clauses.explanation: Some circumstances may limit or affect a benefit. Review the full exclusions and current insurer terms before relying on the cover.
